raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 holds a second ingest at 22:00 on top of its normal 02:00 load, which is where the 15th distinct ingest_ts comes from. That re-delivery added 23 rows whose txn_id already exists (4825 rows vs 4802 distinct ids, with ids contiguous from 900001 to 904802), and 22 of those keys survive the POSTED filter as duplicates in silver. The fix keeps one row per txn_id, choosing the latest ingested version before filtering on status, so a later status change such as a reversal is respected.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
